title: LibreDWG AcDs reader-source, release, and writer boundary
mode: deeper/broader primary-source research and plan refinement; bounded local oracle calibration attempted
scope: Reconcile LibreDWG issue #1411's pinned release report with current master source.
Separate AcDs section reading, writer availability, exact SAB profile, and semantic geometry evidence.
Attempt a bounded binary-DXF oracle control using only generated scratch artifacts.

sources.finding: The issue report pins the observed R2013+ AcDs/SAB loss to LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at 8a1ae764 and provides a reproducible ezdxf-generated R2018 DXF recipe plus a separate confidential DWG report.
sources.evidenceClass: release-specific peer bug report; not independently reproduced here

sources.finding: Current master contains read_2007_section_acds() and dispatches it from R2007+ metadata processing; this establishes source-visible reader code, not the behavior of the reported release or a successful run.

The schema reader parses AcDs indexes/schemas, scans the section data for ACIS BinaryFile spans, and associates extracted spans through the queued 3DSOLID handle list. Some segment bodies are explicitly warned as unhandled; no encoder block is present in the inspected file.
sources.evidenceClass: mutable source-level structural-reader inspection; not semantic or writer qualification

sources.finding: The current build source list leaves encode_r2007.c commented out, consistent with the narrower DWG writer scope described by the project documentation.
Project tool documentation says current dxf2dwg/dwgwrite does not write R2007 DWG, distinguishing broad read coverage from narrower writer capability.
sources.evidenceClass: project-published tool scope; no peer executable was run

sources.finding: ezdxf documents SAT for DXF R2000-R2010 and SAB for R2013+, while its mesh projection is limited to flat polygonal faces and is not a general ACIS kernel.
sources.evidenceClass: peer DXF profile documentation and explicit semantic limit

sources.finding: The visible ACadRust helper manufactures an ASM BinaryFile marker envelope and its planar-body DWG test uses the same library writer and reader; these are not interchangeable with LibreDWG's ACIS BinaryFile scan or independent semantic acceptance.
sources.evidenceClass: peer self-test source inspection; mutable main branch

assessment.issue1411: Keep as a negative report for the pinned 0.14.8593 route. Current master has a reader code path, so the broad present-tense claim that LibreDWG has no AcDs reader is stale for inspected master source; whether the reported release bug is fixed is unverified.
assessment.readerWriterBoundary: Current source supplies structural AcDs parsing and SAB extraction code, but the inspected AcDs schema contains no encoder path and project build/docs do not establish a modern R2013+ DWG writer. Do not use LibreDWG as a positive modern AcDs writer candidate without new source and artifact evidence.
assessment.profileBoundary: Keep ACIS BinaryFile, ASM BinaryFile, ACIS 21800, and version-specific SAT/SAB carrier paths separately named and tested.
assessment.localOracleCalibration: LibreDWG dxfwrite produced a binary scratch DXF but emitted duplicate-handle and unknown-MATERIAL warnings. ODA File Converter 27.1.0 aborted during macOS Cocoa/pasteboard initialization before readback. Calibration outcome is NOT_RUN; no defect or support claim follows.

planUpdate: Bind peer observations to exact release/commit, build configuration, platform, format version, conversion direction, input hash/provenance, diagnostics, and per-record output disposition.

Treat current LibreDWG master as an optional structural reader comparison only; compare section framing, segment/index/key association, owner handle, payload length/hash, and semantics in separate stages.
Do not port scan-and-queue logic without ODA/spec/sample evidence and a local ownership/identity audit; retain the existing owner-keyed local AcDs route.
Keep the generated issue reproducer scratch-only; require a distinct producer and pre-authored expected manifest for positive modern DWG semantic qualification.
At the existing composed validation checkpoint only, mark unavailable ODA/native routes NOT_RUN and continue the next dependency-ready local implementation slice.
